engine: r1864's drawn location map — the THIRD map dialect in the library. A hand-styled vector district map on a warm-taupe / near-black field: a winding slate-blue RIVER band, filled green PARK blobs, a thin road network, white LANDMARK GLYPHS with labels (Kremlin, cathedral, gallery), terracotta circular POI PINS with white category icons + labels, and a big copper PROJECT DISC ('1864 / Софийская наб., 36') at the centre. NOT live Mapbox/Leaflet — inline SVG + positioned DOM. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18645 /location).
family_note: DISTINCT from the two existing maps: line-art-location-map (11tanjung) = monochrome line-art, cream-on-brown, leader-line POIs; watercolor-svg-map (Springs) = painterly cream colour-blobs that rise then pin. THIS = a TINTED-DARK base + a river band + filled park/footprint shapes + terracotta pins with glyph icons + a copper project disc. A third dialect, its own engine. (The contacts map is this engine with a single ОФИС ПРОДАЖ pill -> the themed-contact-map variant.)

measured_teardown.move: scroll-into-view reveal, progress p 0..1. The river path [data-river] draws via stroke-dashoffset (length -> 0) over 0..0.5; .rtm-park/.rtm-road shapes fade in 0..0.45; landmark glyphs [data-glyph] fade + translateY 10->0 over 0.30..0.70 (small stagger); POI pins [data-poi] pop scale 0.5->1 + opacity over 0.45..1, bottom-to-top stagger; the project disc [data-disc] scales 0.7->1 + fades over 0.55..0.85. Hover a pin -> .is-hot (dot scale 1.15 + brighter + label opacity 1). set(p) is a PURE scrub.
measured_teardown.cited: r18645 /location: warm-black/taupe field, a slate-blue Moskva river band winding through, green park blobs, thin roads, white landmark line-glyphs (Кремль / Храм Христа Спасителя / ГЭС-2 / Третьяковская галерея), terracotta circular pins with icons (ГУМ / Парк Зарядье / Филармония / Музеон / Дом музыки), a copper '1864 / СОФИЙСКАЯ НАБЕРЕЖНАЯ 36' disc at centre.

draw.what: draw the river band via stroke-dashoffset on reveal; false = present, only glyphs/pins/disc animate.

stagger.what: spacing between POI pins in the bottom-to-top ladder.

duration.what: base reveal duration; total = duration + stagger*pinCount.

once.what: play once or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis.

entry: RiverTintedPoiMap.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target = .rtm-stage > svg.rtm-map ([data-river] path + .rtm-park/.rtm-road shapes + [data-glyph] landmark groups) + .rtm-pin[data-poi] (.dot icon + .lbl) positioned by left/top + .rtm-disc[data-disc] (.n + .rtm-disc-cap). The SVG should be preserveAspectRatio='none' so the hand-art fills the stage and the %-positioned DOM pins align. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub.
law: stroke-dashoffset (river) + transform (translateY glyphs, scale pins/disc) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL (hand-styled SVG, NOT Mapbox); reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown. owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view reveal). The map art + POI positions are COMPOSITION; the engine drives the reveal + hover. Use font-independent glyphs in the pins (SVG/unicode marks), NOT emoji (no emoji font in many render contexts).
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (not pinned). Verify the river draws (dashoffset->0), parks fade, glyphs rise, pins ladder (scale 0.5->1), the disc scales in AT its position; hover a pin lights it + its label. The SVG must be preserveAspectRatio='none' so the art fills the stage + the DOM pins align (else the slice-crop misaligns them). Smoothness via the scroll path.
proven: lab: a hand-authored Moskva-bend map (river band, 4 park blobs, 3 roads, 3 landmark glyphs, 8 terracotta pins, a copper '1864 / Софийская наб., 36' disc). Curve measured live (p / river-dashoff / park-op / disc-op / pin-scales): 0 / 2653 / 0 / 0 / [.5,.5,.5] -> 0.30 / 425 / 0.89 / 0 / [.5,.5,.5] -> 0.55 / 0 / 1 / 0 / [.5,.5,.5] -> 0.80 / 0 / 1 / 0.97 / [.79,.56,.93] (bottom-to-top stagger) -> 1 / 0 / 1 / 1 / [1,1,1]. Screenshot (disc centred): the copper '1864' disc + 'Софийская наб., 36' caption, terracotta pins (Парк Зарядье / Филармония / Музеон / Дом музыки) with glyph icons, slate-blue river band + green parks (matches r1864 /location). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 1/564 long frames (0.2%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
